# GigaMail

> GigaMail is a free desktop app and MCP server that brings ChatGPT, Claude, Codex or any AI agent into the mailbox you already have (Microsoft 365/Outlook, Gmail and any IMAP account). The agent searches mail, reads attachments, drafts replies and books meetings; nothing is sent, deleted or moved without the user's approval, given outside the agent's reach. Mail, indexes and credentials stay on the user's computer: GigaMail runs no cloud service.

Key facts:

- Platforms: desktop app for Windows 10/11 (code-signed), macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized) and Linux (.deb and AppImage, beta). The app updates itself.
- Core without the app: `pip install gigamail` (MCP server, CLI, watcher). MCP command: `gigamail-server`, stdio only, no network port.
- Works with: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Google Antigravity and any MCP client.
- Price: free forever, for personal and business use.
- Approval model: reads are free; sending, deleting and other actions with effects outside the computer wait for a human approval from the console, the CLI, a desktop notification or Telegram. The agent only gets an inert request id and cannot approve itself through the MCP channel.
- Privacy: no GigaMail server receives mail or credentials. Mail the agent reads is handled by that agent's model provider. A masker can hide tax codes, IBANs, emails and phone numbers before the agent sees them.
- Features: hybrid search (provider + local index), a local archive of every account with attachments, sender memory and contact notes, calendar-aware drafts that only propose free times, knowledge files per account (price lists, terms), signed automation rules.
- MCP tools: 31 (18 reads, 3 audited writes, 10 actions behind human approval).
- How it differs: unlike AgentMail it uses your existing mailbox, not new hosted inboxes; unlike Composio it runs on your computer, not through a cloud that holds your logins; unlike Copilot in Outlook it is free, works with any IMAP mailbox and lets you choose the agent.
- Source code: https://github.com/adecubed/gigamail (AGPL-3.0). MCP registry name: io.github.adecubed/gigamail.

- [Install](https://gigamail.ai/install.html): every installer, the pip core, and manual setup for each agent

- [Latest release](https://github.com/adecubed/gigamail/releases/latest): installers with SHA-256 digests

## Comparisons

- [GigaMail vs AgentMail](https://gigamail.ai/gigamail-vs-agentmail.html): your own mailbox, or new inboxes for agents
- [GigaMail vs Composio](https://gigamail.ai/gigamail-vs-composio.html): your mail on your computer, or a thousand apps through a cloud
- [GigaMail vs Copilot in Outlook](https://gigamail.ai/gigamail-vs-copilot.html): the agent you choose, or the one Microsoft builds in
